title: Content Assets Creation Plan
body:
# Content Assets - Commission Comparison & Demo Videos

## Asset 1: Commission Comparison Graphic

### Purpose
Visual proof that BroLab's 0% commission model is superior to competitor platforms

### Format
Horizontal graphic (1200x675px) - optimized for Twitter/Instagram

### Content
Comparison table showing:
- BroLab: 0% commission, 100% to creator, $0.00 fees on $100 beat sale
- Beatstars: 20-30% commission, 70-80% to creator, $20-30 on $100 sale
- Gumroad: 10% + payment fees (3.5%), ~13.5% total, ~$13.50 on $100
- Etsy: 3-6.5% + transaction fees, ~8-9% total, ~$8-9 on $100

### Design Elements
- BroLab column highlighted (green/branded color)
- Clear visual hierarchy showing 100% value for creator
- Subtle branding, not aggressive
- Font: Clean, readable (Arial, Helvetica, or similar)
- Include subtle attribution (BroLab 2026)

### Tools
Canva free template or simple Figma design
- Designer: Anyone with basic Canva/design skills
- Time estimate: 30 minutes
- Deliverable: PNG + high-res JPG versions

## Asset 2: Product Demo Video (30-60 seconds)

### Purpose
Short, punchy video showing BroLab checkout in action - proving instant delivery and ease of use

### Content Sequence
1. **Hook (3-5 sec)**: "Watch a beat sell in 30 seconds"
2. **Demo (20-30 sec)**:
   - Creator landing page screenshot
   - Customer discovers beat
   - Add to cart click
   - BroLab checkout appears
   - Payment processed
   - "Sold!" confirmation
   - Instant download notification
3. **CTA (5-8 sec)**: "0% commission. Instant delivery. Keep 100%."

### Format
- Vertical (9:16) for TikTok/Instagram Reels
- Also create 16:9 version for YouTube/Twitter
- Resolution: 1080p minimum
- Overlay text, arrows showing key interactions

### Tools
- Screen recording: OBS/ScreenFlow + video editor
- Or: Loom for quick screen record
- Editing: iMovie, DaVinci Resolve (free), or CapCut
- Time estimate: 1-2 hours

## Asset 3: Creator Interview Template

### Purpose
Reusable template for featuring creator stories in content

### Components
- Creator photo/avatar (1:1 square, min 400x400px)
- Quote section: "Why I switched to BroLab" (60-80 chars)
- Key metric: "Earnings increase", "Time saved", etc.
- Call-to-action: "Join [Name] on BroLab"
- BroLab branding/logo

### Template Format
Canva template with editable text fields and image placeholders

### Usage
One new creator feature per week on social media

### Time Estimate: 1 hour

## Asset 4: Thread Templates (Twitter/X)

### Purpose
Reusable thread structures for consistent, high-engagement content

### Thread A: "Why I Left [Platform]"
1. Hook: "Just migrated my beat catalog to BroLab. Here's why..."
2-4. Pain points with [Platform] (fees, delivery, control)
5. BroLab solution for each pain point
6. CTA: "Join 100+ creators already here"

### Thread B: "The Math of Selling Beats"
1. Hook: "Ever calculated how much platforms are taking?"
2-4. Breakdown of fees across platforms (Beatstars, Gumroad, etc.)
5. BroLab alternative
6. CTA: Numbers don't lie

### Thread C: "Creator Success Story"
1. Hook: "[Creator Name] sold 50 beats this month"
2-3. Their journey, challenges, solution
4-5. Results with BroLab
6. CTA: "What would you do with 100% of your earnings?"

### Delivery
- 3 thread templates as editable text/notion docs
- Placeholders for: creator names, numbers, pain points
- CTA variations (3 different versions)

## Execution Timeline

### Priority 1 (Monday 2026-04-08) - CRITICAL BLOCKER
- Commission comparison graphic: MUST have for Twitter posts
- 30-60 second demo video: High priority
- Time: 2-3 hours total

### Priority 2 (Tuesday-Wednesday)
- Creator interview template: Setup for ongoing use
- Thread templates: Content structure for week
- Time: 1-2 hours

## Quality Standards
- All graphics: Minimum 1200x675px, 72dpi
- All videos: 1080p+ resolution
- All designs: On-brand colors and fonts
- All text: Error-free, professional tone

## Success Metrics
- All assets production-ready by Tuesday 2026-04-09
- Graphics: Used in 2-3 Twitter posts by Wednesday
- Video: Posted and tracked for engagement by Thursday
- Templates: Enable consistent content creation all week

## Tools & Resources Needed
- Figma account (free tier ok) OR Canva Pro ($13/mo)
- Video editor (DaVinci Resolve free, or CapCut)
- Screenshot tool (Mac: screenshot, Windows: Snip & Sketch)
- Product demo access (login to BroLab staging/production)
